_meta.what_this_is: The full population of actors as a 5x5 grid of (talent, looks) ratings, one person per combination. Because every combination appears exactly once, the two traits are independent by construction and their population correlation is exactly 0. A studio casts anyone whose talent + looks reaches the threshold -- selection that depends on BOTH traits, which makes cast/not-cast a collider.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. The grid and the casting threshold are hand-authored so independence in the population is exact and the induced negative correlation in the cast subset is checkable; every correlation is computed in collider.py.
_meta.format: people: [{talent, looks}] each 1..5; threshold: cast if talent + looks >= threshold.
